name: Netlink Solutions (India) Limited
about: Netlink Solutions (India) Limited provides website and information technology services in India. The company operates through four segments: Website and Information Technology Services, Information Media, Exhibition Management, and Treasury Management. It engages in the web site design, SEO, server space, domain booking and renewal, and organizing exhibition. The company also provides exhibition management service; and investment services. Netlink Solutions (India) Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
